purpose: Audit whether the apparent development advantage and coverage tradeoff support selection for a new focused, prospective campaign.

baseline_error_audit.finding: The compact Luna packets did not expose the complete robot-visible method_input or exact source/configuration excerpts that R was allowed to inspect. Most challenged R assertions are directly present in those inputs or reproducible with the allowed deterministic calculations. The historical labels are valid descriptions of packet-relative support, but they are not a fair estimate of R's material-error risk under evidence-complete judging.

verified_examples.challenged_claim: local/global costmap dimensions and ComputePathToPose-to-FollowPath wiring
2640 cells at cost >=253, 374 lethal cells, rolling-grid extent, Navfn and scan-obstacle configuration
43.349 s duration, command offsets/count, aborted error code 105 and result locator
verified_examples.remaining_language_issue: The statement that actuator acceptance is required for any physical attribution is broader than the evidence; alternative discriminators can establish some physical causes. This wording must not be treated as a generally valid rule.

verified_examples.challenged_claim: all ten one-second odometry medians were 0.000 m/s, event locators, and 10 s movement allowance
5--67 s per-window healthy medians, 67.432 s duration, and event locators

verified_examples.remaining_language_issue: Ephemeral absolute /tmp links are not governed citations even though the repository-relative files and hashes are correct.

verified_examples.challenged_claim: 240 by 240 cells, 3648 cells at cost >=253, and 563 lethal cells

baseline_error_audit.consequence: Do not use the historical 14/18 versus 0/18 material-error counts or the three apparent consensus wins as evidence that P beats a fairly judged R. New judge packets must include the complete facts available to both methods or explicitly mark extra claims unresolved.

candidate_omission_audit.rule: Essential status follows the question's declared purpose, not which method omitted the unit.

cases.reason: The question explicitly asks how the measured trajectory changed; stating only that it departed, without its decisive magnitude, is incomplete.
The question asks for useful supported path evidence; the retained trajectory magnitude is part of that requested evidence.
The question explicitly asks whether the trigger can be established with cells unavailable.
The question asks what the retained evidence establishes about the route change.
The question expressly asks what is not established about a physical restriction.
The question expressly requests retained-grid, plan, trajectory, and causal-limit findings.

candidate_omission_audit.consequence: The historical v2 4/4 endpoint score is not the new complete-supported-diagnostic-communication endpoint. Current v2 may be selected unchanged only for prospectively atomic questions whose essential units it actually renders. Composite or broader questions require a new candidate version.

fairness_audit.resource_interpretation: P is a deterministic checked renderer; any positive result is a specialized-computation/composition result, not an LLM-reasoning or prompting advantage.

selected_question_families: bounded geometric restriction with one decisive grid/footprint comparison and required causal limits
persistent command-to-motion discrepancy with one healthy-versus-event comparison and required causal limits
measured response recovery with outcome and chronology-versus-causation limit
excluded_from_primary_claim: questions that require every plan and trajectory detail
selection.rationale: The deterministic candidate was factually restrained in all 18 development judgments and communicated the atomic mechanism in every eligible development case. Its apparent comparative advantage is unproven after the judge-packet defect, so selection is based on bounded treatment plausibility and deterministic auditability, not an asserted effect.
